title: Semantic Regions, Interactables & Governed Triggers
objective: Make already-governed cells, cell areas, rooms, named zones and gridless regions first-class interaction surfaces and bind authorized entry/exit/presence/interact/state-change signals to versioned, idempotent owner-operation proposals without creating a duplicate trigger, rules or ownership ledger.
preserved_boundaries: Authorization-before-projection filtered hidden/GM-only regions, interactables, trigger metadata and protected cardinality before ISE-04 input.
Scene regions and owner-domain objects remained canonical; ISE-04 created no duplicate ownership, trigger or rules ledger.
Entry/exit/presence/interact/state-change semantics remained owner/profile-authored and required existing owner-operation proposals.
Expected owner version, idempotency, permission decisions, consent, GM adjudication and Action/Event or owner-domain validation remained mandatory.
No canonical Scene/owner mutation, permission grant, automatic canonical fire or durable trigger-runtime persistence was implemented.
Migration 0022 was not reserved; mapless theater-of-the-mind remained valid.
ISE-05+ feature scope, paid provider activation, unauthorized media redistribution, tester distribution, release and deployment were not authorized.
next_action: ISE-04 is completed_verified and its implementation authority is retired. ISE-05 is selected_not_started only; a future owner Continue is required before governed start or product mutation.
